title: Redis results: after a lost pub/sub connection the client reads the keys before it subscribes again; a task that finishes in between is never seen, and get() waits until its timeout or for ever
where: redis.py:251-271 (celery 768e476, the same at 9c2f238): _reconnect_pubsub runs MGET of every subscribed key and then SUBSCRIBE on a new connection; the order came with celery PR 5921 (2020). No upstream thread on this cause found (searched pubsub reconnect, reconnect_pubsub, mget subscribe, result get hangs redis reconnect, missed result message pubsub); closest symptom: open celery issue 4039 (2017, get() raises TimeoutError though the task succeeded, Redis backend, about 1 in 30), which predates this code; not in the tracker yet
thread: none yet (a new issue candidate, or a reply on celery issue 4039; the lead decides)
observed: 9c2f238 with kombu 445027e, redis-py 8.1.0, Redis 7 (broker db 10, results db 11), a real prefork worker -c 1 writing results straight to Redis; the client's result backend goes through Toxiproxy (6392 -> 6379). Injected: 1000 ms latency on the proxy's replies (widens the window), CLIENT KILL of the client's pub/sub connection; the task ends when the script sets a release key. gap (released when MONITOR shows the client's MGET after the kill): 4 of 4 get(timeout=20) raised TimeoutError after 20.3 s with SUCCESS stored; MONITOR order MGET < PUBLISH < SUBSCRIBE. Controls: before (task done before the kill) 2 of 2 returned; after (released after the new SUBSCRIBE) 2 of 2 returned after 7.3 s, order MGET < SUBSCRIBE < PUBLISH; nokill 2 of 2 returned. natural (no latency, no release key, 50 ms tasks, the kill at a random time 0 to 80 ms after get() subscribed): 0 of 200 timed out, the window is a few round trips on localhost. The design subscribeFirst (SUBSCRIBE before the MGET) passes quietDone in the model (subfirst_cut, subfirst_cut2).
